producer_report.summary:
The shared CLI test config now sets `[disk] min_free_gb = 0` with a comment, so tests no longer depend on the machine's free disk. The production default of 10 GB is unchanged.

To simulate low space in a spawned binary, `df_free_bytes` in `disk.rs` now returns the value of the `ATHENA_FREE_BYTES` environment variable when it holds a whole number. Anything else falls through to `df`.

In `binary.rs` I split the nested ask/go into a helper and added two tests:
- **Companion:** the nested run with 9 GB simulated passes, because the test config has no minimum.
- **Control:** the same run with a 10 GB minimum fails with 'environment: low disk: 9.0 GB free, 10.0 GB required'. This shows the simulation takes effect.

A new `with_min_free_gb` helper in `common/mod.rs` sets the minimum. The disk tests in `drain.rs` now build their fixture with a 10 GB minimum, since they would otherwise stop holding at the new default of 0. They still use their own simulated readings.

The CHANGELOG has an entry under Unreleased.

checks_run.note: 15 passed, including the companion and control

checks_run.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain --test introspection --test job_plan

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test binary`: a_nested_run_works_in_a_scratch_copy_with_fake_agents passes, and a companion test simulates low free space (below 10 GB) in the nested run's environment and still passes because the test config sets min_free_gb to 0.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran it: 15 passed. a_nested_run_ignores_low_free_space_because_the_test_config_has_no_minimum runs the nested ask/go with ATHENA_FREE_BYTES=9000000000 and passes. The control the_simulated_free_space_reaches_the_nested_run_when_a_minimum_is_set (minimum 10) fails the go with 'environment: low disk: 9.0 GB free, 10.0 GB required'.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core disk`: the disk guard's tests still show a hold (job stays queued, 'environment: low disk') and a fail-fast with simulated low free space.
criteria_check.evidence: The disk unit tests pass (5, including the new override-parsing test). The hold and fail-fast tests are in athena-cli drain.rs; I ran that file, 84 passed, including the low_disk hold test (Proposed, 3.0 GB free, 10.0 GB required), the before-checks fail-fast with a retry hint, and the_real_steps_hold test. They now use disk_fixture() with min_free_gb = 10.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-cli/tests/common/mod.rs test_config sets [disk] min_free_gb = 0 with a comment explaining why, and the production default (10 GB in athena-data config) is unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: Read common/mod.rs: test_config appends [disk] min_free_gb = 0 with a comment. athena-data was not touched; DEFAULT_MIN_FREE_GB stays 10.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test --locked`, `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass, and no test in the suite reads the machine's real free disk to decide its result.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full test suite and fmt. I ran clippy (pass) and the binary, drain, introspection, job_plan and core disk tests. The only test that reads real df is the_real_reader, which asserts > 0 and does not depend on the amount.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry stating that tests no longer depend on real free disk space and how the minimum or free-space reading is set in tests.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a bullet at the top of Unreleased/Changed. It names test_config's min_free_gb = 0, with_min_free_gb, simulated values and ATHENA_FREE_BYTES.

open_issues: I did not run the full cargo test or lifecycle.rs; they are left to Athena's checks.
ATHENA_FREE_BYTES is a production-code test hook. If it is set by mistake in a real environment it masks the real disk reading; it is documented and ignored unless it is a whole number.
mistakes: My first placement of the [disk] block sat before [classes] and would have been dropped by config_with_change_checks; I moved it to the end of the config before running anything.
learnings: config_with_change_checks replaces everything between the checks block and [classes], so the [disk] table must come after [classes] (the end of the config) to survive it.
The hold and fail-fast tests live in athena-cli tests/drain.rs; the athena-core disk tests only cover parsing, markers and the sweep.
